basic_details.scholarship_name: Gulf University for Science and Technology (GUST) Fellowships
basic_details.offering_entity: Gulf University for Science and Technology (GUST) Graduate Studies & Research Office
basic_details.host_institutions_covered: Gulf University for Science and Technology (West Mishref Campus, Kuwait)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Master of Science in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering), Master of Science in Information Technology, Applied Mathematics, and Master of Business Administration (MBA / Management Information Systems).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: Approximately 15 to 25 competitive Graduate Assistantships (GA) & Research Fellowships awarded annually across graduate programs
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Merit-based open international competition; typically 3 to 6 Pakistani graduate fellows selected annually in Computer Science and IT
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 24 months (2 academic years for full-time master's studies subject to maintaining semester CGPA >= 3.25)

nationality_requirements: Open to all nationalities worldwide, including international applicants from Pakistan and expatriate residents in Kuwait
eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: No statutory upper age limit, but candidates must be early-career researchers or fresh graduates typically under 35 years old.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Recognized 4-year Bachelor's degree (16-year BS/BSc/BE) in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or closely related quantitative field from an HEC-recognized university with minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00 (75%+).
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00; competitive graduate fellows typically maintain CGPA >= 3.50 / 4.00 with top grades in core computer science subjects.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Solid undergraduate foundation in algorithms, data structures, software engineering, databases, and programming languages (Python, Java, C++).
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated with official degree certificate or enrolled in final semester graduating prior to August 2027.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Graduation within the past 5 years preferred.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Relevant software development experience, machine learning projects, or academic tutoring experience is considered advantageous.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: IELTS Academic minimum 6.5 (min 6.0 in writing) or TOEFL iBT minimum 80. MOI certificates are generally not accepted; official test report required.
eligibility_requirements.other_language_requirements: All graduate teaching, examinations, and research at GUST are conducted 100% in English. Arabic language proficiency is not required.
eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Open equally to male and female candidates.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Merit-based Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship scheme rewarding high academic and technical competency.
eligibility_requirements.previous_scholarship_restrictions: Cannot hold dual external sponsorships simultaneously.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition fee waiver for all required master's credit hours (33-36 credit hours worth up to KWD 9,000 total).
tuition_fee.amount: 100% Full Tuition Waiver (up to KWD 9,000 value)

admission_application_fee.details: Non-refundable graduate application fee of KWD 30 (~PKR 27,000) payable online during portal submission.

accommodation.details: Subsidized housing allowance or graduate residence assistance provided in West Mishref/Hawally area near campus.

monthly_stipend.details: Tax-free monthly living stipend of KWD 200 - 300 / month (~PKR 180,000 - 270,000 / month | ~USD 650 - 980/month) for teaching/research assistantship duties.

airfare.details: International travel between Pakistan and Kuwait is self-funded, though relocation assistance is evaluated on a case-by-case basis.

visa_fee.details: GUST sponsors and handles the Kuwait student residence permit (Civil ID, Student Visa) processing.

health_insurance.details: Comprehensive student health coverage through Kuwait private university health network and public clinics.

food_allowance.details: Subsidized campus cafeteria and food court dining across the GUST West Mishref campus.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Free digital access to GUST A.M. Al-Refai Library, ACM Digital Library, IEEE Xplore, and cloud computing resources.
books_and_materials_allowance.amount: Full digital library and computing lab access

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Research grants and travel funds available through GUST Research Office for co-authoring conference papers with faculty.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Subsidized local student transport services and university parking facilities.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single host university (Gulf University for Science and Technology - GUST, Kuwait).
participating_institutions: Gulf University for Science and Technology (West Mishref, Kuwait)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: Ranked #1 private university in Kuwait (QS Arab Region University Rankings; QS World University Rankings); established in partnership with University of Missouri-St. Louis (UMSL).
available_majors: Master of Science in Computer Science (Artificial Intelligence, Cybersecurity, Software Engineering)
Master of Science in Information Technology
Master of Business Administration (MBA - Management, Finance, MIS)
Master of Science in Applied Mathematics
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor degree in Computing, Engineering, or Business with CGPA >= 3.20/4.00, official IELTS 6.5+ or TOEFL 80+, statement of motivation, two recommendation letters, and interview with graduate committee.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Unified graduate admission and assistantship application; Computer Science AI track is the most competitive.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Demonstrate strong hands-on coding skills, machine learning project experience, and willingness to assist faculty with undergraduate lab instruction.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: GUST Graduate Admissions & Financial Aid Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an account on the GUST Online Admissions Portal (gust.edu.kw/admissions), select Master of Science in Computer Science, select 'Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship Application', upload transcripts and credentials, and pay the KWD 30 application fee before May 15.
step_by_step_workflow: Step 1: Check admission guidelines and faculty research profiles on the GUST Graduate Studies & Research portal (gust.edu.kw/graduate_studies).
Step 2: Prepare HEC/MoFA-attested Bachelor degree, official transcripts, IELTS/TOEFL scorecard, and CV.
Step 3: Register an account on GUST Online Admissions Portal.
Step 4: Complete the graduate application form and check the Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship consideration box.
Step 5: Upload required academic documents, personal statement, and portfolio of technical projects.
Step 6: Pay the KWD 30 application fee online via credit card.
Step 7: Provide contact details for two academic referees who will submit letters directly.
Step 8: Attend an online technical and motivation interview with the Department of Computer Science Graduate Committee in June.
Step 9: Receive admission and assistantship award letter in July; GUST coordinates visa sponsorship and onboarding.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated Routing: Students apply for graduate program admission and indicate interest in the Graduate Assistantship / Fellowship within the single institutional portal.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted electronically by academic professors via referee links sent by the GUST Admissions Office.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of purpose (max 750 words) describing academic accomplishments, technical projects, interest in GUST graduate research, and motivation for graduate assistantship duties.
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: Preliminary research statement (1-2 pages) describing intended master's thesis topic in AI, cybersecurity, or data systems.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Standard professional academic CV highlighting programming languages, open-source repositories, projects, and academic honors.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Virtual interview via Zoom/Teams with graduate program director focusing on programming skills, teaching readiness, and research interests.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: IELTS Academic 6.5+ or TOEFL iBT 80+; GRE General Test optional but strongly recommended for funding competition.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: KWD 30 (~PKR 27,000 / ~$98 USD) non-refundable graduate application fee.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC and MoFA Pakistan attestations required; Kuwait Embassy attestation required upon admission confirmation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Official English translation for all academic records.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: Online submission via GUST Graduate Admissions Portal.

required_documents_checklist.specification: HEC-attested 4-year BS in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field.
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Attested by HEC and MoFA Pakistan.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Complete undergraduate semester transcripts showing minimum CGPA 3.20 / 4.00.
Official IELTS Academic (minimum 6.5) or TOEFL iBT (minimum 80) scorecard.
Statement explaining academic interests and readiness for graduate teaching/research assistantship responsibilities.
Detailed CV highlighting software toolsets, machine learning projects, and publications.
Confidential appraisal letters from undergraduate faculty.
Clear color scan of passport information page valid for at least 2 years.

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Applications open in February with deadline in mid-May for the Fall intake; assistantship awards are finalized by mid-July.

selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 10% (Quality of SOP and motivation for assistantship responsibilities)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Technical interview performance, communication skills, and teaching suitability)
selection_process_and_weights.financial_need_weight: 0% (Pure academic excellence and assistantship suitability evaluation)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: GUST Graduate Studies Council, Department Head of Computer Science, and Graduate Program Director.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Multi-stage rubric evaluating transcript credentials, programming proficiency, and candidate interview performance.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~800 to 1,200 international applicants across graduate programs
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates in computer science or software engineering with practical experience in machine learning, web/mobile architectures, and lab teaching skills.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates from FAST-NUCES, NUST, COMSATS, UET Lahore, and IBA Karachi.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: Pakistan, India, Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Kuwait (expatriate residents), Nigeria.

fake_websites_and_scams: Only apply directly through official GUST portal at gust.edu.kw.
Never pay third-party agents claiming to guarantee GUST assistantships or visas.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Only the official KWD 30 application fee is charged by the university.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: GUST does not partner with recruitment agents; direct applications only.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Security deposit for local apartment housing: ~KWD 150 - 200 (~PKR 135,000 - 180,000).
misleading_claims_debunked: Myth: GUST is an Arabic-medium university. Reality: GUST is an American-style university modeled after UMSL where 100% of instruction and administrative communication is in English.
Myth: Assistantships require 40 hours of teaching per week. Reality: Graduate assistants provide 10-15 hours per week of tutoring, grading, or lab supervision.
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Unofficial blogs suggest Duolingo is accepted; GUST Graduate Admissions strictly requires official IELTS Academic or TOEFL iBT.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.25 / 4.00 each semester to retain tuition waiver and monthly stipend.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Mandatory full-time graduate study and fulfillment of 12-15 hours per week of assigned teaching or research assistantship duties.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semester-by-semester review by Graduate Program Director and supervising faculty.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Outside commercial employment in Kuwait is prohibited while holding a funded Graduate Assistantship.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No mandatory return bond; graduates can pursue careers in Kuwait, the GCC, or international doctoral programs.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.service_obligations_or_bonds: Scholars must serve as Graduate Teaching Assistants (GTA) assisting with lab demonstrations and grading, or Graduate Research Assistants (GRA).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation of assistantship and loss of tuition waiver if semester GPA falls below 3.00 or if assistantship responsibilities are neglected.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing degree program requires formal re-application to the Graduate Council.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is provided for a maximum of 4 semesters (2 academic years); extensions require special dean approval.
